steps.content:
Buy from **seller A - Ottervale Audio**:

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/wv2qyp/a

Not seller B - Brackmoor Sound:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/wv2qyp/b

They look identical on everything else:

* **Same product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite
* **Same price:** $129.00
* **Same rating:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* **Same fulfillment:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* **Same returns:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.

The difference is warranty / authorization:

* Seller B claims: **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."**
* Seller A does *not* claim that. It just links to Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers.

Quellwyn's official list says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/wv2qyp/dealers

Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.

So Seller B's claim to be authorized with full manufacturer warranty is false. Even though price, shipping, and specs are the same, that false claim is a red flag about trustworthiness.

**Caveat:** Per Quellwyn, you won't get full manufacturer warranty from *either* of these two, since neither is authorized. If full manufacturer warranty matters to you, buy from one of the actual authorized dealers instead: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.

If you have to pick between these two, pick Ottervale Audio because it doesn't misrepresent its status.
